pages.text: $(o)All fifteen runes are in place. The Receptacle has consumed itself and left this page in its place.$()
The first phase is over: the Portal is no longer scaffolding. But it still cannot be opened.
What is missing lies above the clouds. The Order raised an island there, far from the Portal, that drops into the void on every side: there is no path and no ladder. Look for it in the sky.
